purpose: The SECOND link of the land chain.  screen_land_parity.py proves the BOARD's footprint equals its LIBRARY MASTER, to the nanometre.  That is worth nothing on its own -- it only says the board agrees with a file.  This index says which drawing that file was ruled against, and where the ruling is written down.  Together the two links are: board land == library master == manufacturer/IPC drawing.

U1.what_differs: the footprint-embedded ANTENNA KEEP-OUT rule area's copper-layer set: the master names all 32, the board's copy names F.Cu / B.Cu / In1.Cu / In2.Cu -- KiCad clamped it to the stackup the board had when U1 was placed and never re-expanded it when In3.Cu and In4.Cu were added
U1.status: OPEN FABRICATION BLOCKER, measured at D-616: In3.Cu carries 273.697 mm2 of +3V3 plane and 4 track segments (Net-(SW9-A), USB_VBUS_CHG) and In4.Cu 304.259 mm2 of GND pour inside the 330 mm2 on-board keep-out. Evidence evidence/d616-footprint-keepouts.json; instrument screen_footprint_keepouts.py. It is NOT closed by declaring it here -- this entry exists so LAND4 names the divergence instead of ignoring it.

tiers.1: manufacturer drawing read, document number and dimensions recorded
tiers.2A: vendor-specific stock footprint, drawing read at B-03 closure (FBV2-S2-002)
tiers.2_OPEN: vendor-specific stock footprint, drawing NOT re-read -- an OPEN item, not a pass
tiers.3: generic JEDEC / IPC package, correct by package identity
